description: Test suite for parsing and validating search parameters in Mattermost, including functions for splitting search strings, parsing flags, and validating date formats.

methods.name: TestSplitWords
methods.description: Unit tests for the splitWords function, verifying correct tokenization of search strings with quotes, hashtags, and special characters.

methods.name: TestParseSearchFlags2
methods.description: Unit tests for parseSearchFlags, checking correct extraction of search words and flags from tokenized input.

methods.name: TestParseSearchParams
methods.description: Unit tests for ParseSearchParams, verifying correct parsing of search strings into SearchParams objects with various date, channel, user, extension, and hashtag filters.

methods.name: TestGetOnDateMillis
methods.description: Tests for converting date strings into start and end milliseconds, including handling invalid dates.

methods.name: TestGetBeforeDateMillis
methods.description: Tests for converting 'before' date strings into milliseconds, including invalid date handling.

methods.name: TestGetAfterDateMillis
methods.description: Tests for converting 'after' date strings into milliseconds, including invalid date handling.

methods.name: TestIsSearchParamsListValid
methods.description: Validation tests for lists of SearchParams, ensuring consistency in include/exclude flags.
